subject: Matemática
description_pt: Comparar quantidades de objetos de dois conjuntos, por estimativa e/ou por correspondência (um a um, dois a dois, entre outros), para indicar “tem mais”, “tem menos” ou “tem a mesma quantidade”, indicando, quando for o caso, quantos a mais e quantos a menos.

components.description_pt: Estimar se um conjunto tem mais, menos ou a mesma quantidade que outro conjunto
components.description_en: Estimate whether one set of objects has more, fewer, or the same amount as another set
components.cc_component_description: Identify whether the number of objects in one group is equal to the number of objects in another group

components.description_pt: Comparar dois conjuntos usando correspondência um a um para determinar qual tem mais ou menos
components.description_en: Compare two sets of objects using one-to-one or other correspondence to determine which has more or fewer
components.cc_component_description: Identify whether the number of objects in one group is equal to the number of objects in another group

components.description_pt: Determinar quantos a mais ou quantos a menos objetos um conjunto tem comparado a outro
components.description_en: Determine how many more or how many fewer objects one set has compared to another
components.cc_component_description: Explain why one quantity is more, less, or equal to another using objects or drawings

cc_matches.description: Identify whether the number of objects in one group is greater than, less than, or equal to the number of objects in another group, e.g., by using matching and counting strategies.
Construct viable arguments and critique the reasoning of others.
